en: Get to the train station and crush the tan defending it.
zh: 抵达火车站并击溃守卫的褐军。

en: Rescue Sarge from the end of the bed
Destroy the Tan base in front of the door.
Get to the door at the end of the counter.
Find a way into Blintz's compound.
zh: 找到进入布林茨营地的路径。

en: Eliminate the Tan to Capture the PlayStation®2 computer entertainment system.
zh: 消灭褐军，夺取 PlayStation(R)2 电脑娱乐系统。

en: Protect the PlayStation®2 computer entertainment system.
zh: 保护 PlayStation(R)2 电脑娱乐系统。

en: Protect the villagers as they make their escape.
Find and Reinforce the Green Kitchen Base
zh: 找到并增援绿军厨房基地

en: Remove the last remaining AA Turret
zh: 清除最后一座防空炮塔
清除剩余 2 座防空炮塔
清除剩余 3 座防空炮塔

en: Escape the basement via the stairs
Escape the basement before the bombing raid occurs
zh: 在轰炸开始前逃离地下室

en: Find a way into the house
Destroy the Tan base in Central Yard
zh: 摧毁中央院落的褐军基地

en: Push through the Tan defense perimeter
Destroy central HQ, located under the table
Eliminate the Tan from the bathroom counter
zh: 消灭浴室柜台上的褐军

en: Demolish the Tan forces at the Attic Pass
zh: 歼灭阁楼通道的褐军部队

en: Claim the kitchen counter before it is flooded
zh: 在被淹没前夺取厨房柜台

en: Get Sarge to the hostages at the Tan Base.
zh: 让中士抵达褐军基地的人质处。

en: Use Sarge to lead the hostages to the extraction point.
zh: 用中士引导人质前往撤离点。

en: Protect the Rocket until it launches.
Knock out the turrets defending the shoreline to allow reinforcements.
zh: 摧毁守卫海岸线的炮塔，为增援开路。

en: Stop all Tan convoy trucks from getting through.
zh: 拦截所有试图突围的褐军车队卡车。

en: Order a Resource Depot, and place it near the two resources.
zh: 订购一座资源站，把它放在两处资源附近。

en: Practice for as long as you want, then move Sarge to the extraction point to complete your training.
zh: 随心练习，练好后将中士移动到撤离点完成训练。

en: Scroll around to move the HQ to your desired location, then press the X button to place it.
zh: 滚动画面，把总部移到想要的位置，然后按叉键放置。

en: Build a unit from the Barracks.
With the Dump Truck highlighted, press the X button once to order.
zh: 高亮自卸卡车后，按一次叉键下单。

en: Use the Bulldozer to place Barbed-Wire Fences on each of the markings.
zh: 用推土机在每个标记处放置铁丝网。

en: To build a Dump Truck, hold the R1 button down and move the left analog stick up or down, or press the up or down directional buttons, to get the HQ's build menu.
zh: 要建造自卸卡车，按住 R1 键并上下推左摇杆，或按方向键上/下，调出总部建造菜单。

en: Melt any building or fence by pressing the L2 button, moving the camera over it, then pressing the X button.
zh: 按 L2 键，把镜头移到目标上，再按叉键即可熔毁任意建筑或围栏。

en: Highlight the upgrade button on the Barracks' Build Menu and press the X button to upgrade.
zh: 在兵营建造菜单中高亮升级按钮，按叉键升级。

en: Select your Bulldozer and hold the R1 button down to call up your Build Menu.
zh: 选中推土机，按住 R1 键调出建造菜单。

en: Use the Bulldozer to construct a Guard Tower.
zh: 用推土机建造一座警卫塔。

en: Highlight the Upgrade button on the HQ's Build Menu and press the X button to Upgrade.
zh: 在总部建造菜单中高亮升级按钮，按叉键升级。

en: Go to the Bulldozer's Build Menu and construct a Garage.
zh: 打开推土机建造菜单，建造一座车库。

en: With the R1 button held, highlight the HQ on the menu, then press the X button to select it.
zh: 按住 R1 键，在菜单中高亮总部，然后按叉键选中它。

en: Select the Bulldozer and build a Barracks.
zh: 选中推土机，建造一座兵营。

en: Select all your units and move them into the first combat area to begin.
zh: 选中所有单位，把它们移入第一处交战区开始。

en: When you're ready, select all your units and move them into the next combat area.
zh: 准备好后，选中所有单位，把它们移入下一处交战区。

en: Select all your units and move them into the next combat area.
zh: 选中所有单位，把它们移入下一处交战区。

en: Move the right analog stick to jump to the targets, then press the X button to fire.
zh: 推右摇杆跳到各个目标处，然后按叉键开火。

en: You can head to the extraction point now, or continue on and practice combat in the challenge course.
zh: 现在可以去撤离点，也可以继续在挑战场练习战斗。

en: Move Sarge to the extraction point.
Press the X button to give the commando units a move order.
zh: 按叉键给突击队员下达移动指令。

en: Select all three commando units at once by tapping the Circle button three times.
zh: 连按三次圆圈键，一次选中全部三个突击队员。

en: Press the L1 button to jump to the enemy units.
zh: 按 L1 键跳到敌方单位处。

en: Do not press the Select button.
Select all seven units on the map at once by moving over each one and pressing the Square button.
zh: 依次移到每个单位上按方块键，一次选中地图上全部七个单位。

en: Scroll over to Sarge and press the Triangle button.
zh: 滚动到中士处，按三角键。

en: Use the left analog stick to move to the extraction point to the north.
zh: 用左摇杆移动到北面的撤离点。

en: Scroll back to your other three units and press the Triangle button to re-select them.
zh: 滚回另外三个单位处，按三角键重新选中它们。

en: Press the L3 button while scrolling to get an added speed boost.
zh: 滚动时按 L3 键可获得额外加速。

en: Scroll anywhere on the map and press the X button to give Sarge a move order.
zh: 在地图任意位置滚动画面，按叉键给中士下达移动指令。

en: When you've had enough, move Sarge to the extraction point to complete your training.
zh: 练够之后，将中士移动到撤离点完成训练。

en: Move the camera so that the target is on top of Sarge, then press the Circle button to select him.
zh: 移动视角，使目标落在中士身上，然后按圆圈键选中他。

en: Hold down the R2 button on the top of the controller and move the left analog stick up or down.
zh: 按住手柄顶部的 R2 键，同时上下推左摇杆。

en: To return to the default camera height, press and release the R2 button without moving the left analog stick.
zh: 要恢复默认视角高度，按住 R2 键后松开，期间不要推动左摇杆。

en: Order a Resource Depot and place it near the two resources.
zh: 订购一座资源站，把它放在两处资源附近。

en: Keep practicing for as long as you want, then move Sarge to the extraction point to complete your training.
zh: 随心练习，练好后将中士移动到撤离点完成训练。

en: Move the HQ to your desired location, then press the left mouse button to place it.
zh: 把总部移到想要的位置，然后按鼠标左键放置。

en: Build a unit from the Barracks.
Use the Bulldozer to place Barbed-Wire Fences on each of the markings.
zh: 用推土机在每个标记处放置铁丝网。

en: Select the HQ and click on the Dump Truck in its Build Menu.
zh: 选中总部，在它的建造菜单中点击自卸卡车。

en: Melt any building or fence by selecting it, then clicking on the Melt button above the Map on the right side of the screen.
zh: 选中建筑或围栏，再点击屏幕右侧地图上方的熔毁按钮将其熔化。

en: Select your Barracks and click on the Upgrade button at the bottom of the Build Menu.
zh: 选中兵营，在建造菜单底部点击升级按钮。

en: Select your Bulldozer to pull up its Build Menu.
zh: 选中推土机，调出它的建造菜单。

en: Use the Bulldozer to construct a Guard Tower.
zh: 用推土机建造一座警卫塔。

en: Select your HQ and click on the Upgrade button at the bottom of the Build Menu.
zh: 选中总部，在建造菜单底部点击升级按钮。

en: When the HQ has finished upgrading, go to the Bulldozer's Build Menu and construct a Garage.
zh: 总部升级完成后，打开推土机建造菜单，建造一座车库。

en: Move your cursor over the HQ on the Build Menu and press the left mouse button to select it.
zh: 把光标移到建造菜单中的总部上，按鼠标左键选中它。

en: Select the Bulldozer and build a Barracks.
zh: 选中推土机，建造一座兵营。

en: Select all your units and move them into the first combat area to begin.
zh: 选中所有单位，把它们移入第一处交战区开始。

en: When you're ready, select all your units and move them into the next combat area.
zh: 准备好后，选中所有单位，把它们移入下一处交战区。

en: Select all your units and move them into the next combat area.
zh: 选中所有单位，把它们移入下一处交战区。

en: Select all your units, hold down the Control key on the keyboard, then press the 1 key to put them in a Squad.
zh: 选中所有单位，按住键盘 Ctrl 键，再按 1 键把他们编成小队。

en: Select the Squad with Sarge, Riff, and Scorch in it.
zh: 选中包含中士、里夫和焦炭的这支小队。

en: Select your new units and place them in a Squad.
zh: 选中新单位，把他们编入小队。

en: You can head to the extraction point now, or continue on and practice combat in the challenge course.
zh: 现在可以去撤离点，也可以继续在挑战场练习战斗。

en: Move Sarge to the extraction point.
Press the left mouse button to give the commando units a move order.
zh: 按鼠标左键给突击队员下达移动指令。

en: Select all three commando units at once by pressing and holding the left mouse button, then dragging the cursor over them.
zh: 按住鼠标左键并拖动光标框住三个突击队员，一次全部选中。

en: Press the space bar to jump to the enemy units.
zh: 按空格键跳到敌方单位处。

en: Select all seven units on the map at once by holding down shift while selecting them.
zh: 按住 Shift 键逐个选择，一次选中地图上全部七个单位。

en: Hold the right mouse button down and scroll forward to center the camera on the extraction point to the north.
zh: 按住鼠标右键并向前滚动，把视角对准北面的撤离点。

en: With Sarge selected, position your cursor anywhere on the map and press the left mouse button to give Sarge a move order.
zh: 选中中士后，把光标移到地图任意位置，按鼠标左键下达移动指令。

en: When you've had enough, move Sarge to the extraction point to complete your training.
zh: 练够之后，将中士移动到撤离点完成训练。

en: Scroll over to Sarge and position your cursor on top of him, then press the left mouse button to select him.
zh: 滚动到中士处并把光标放在他身上，然后按鼠标左键选中他。

en: Use the mouse wheel or control key to zoom the camera up and down.
zh: 用鼠标滚轮或 Ctrl 键上下缩放视角。

You have been awarded a Bronze Medal!
You have been awarded a Gold Medal!

zh: 获得奖章即可解锁这些任务

zh: 一个敌方电脑对手已被消灭。
{1:s} 刚刚给了你 {2:d} 个单位

zh: 按 L2 或 R2 键旋转建筑

en: Use < and > to rotate the building
zh: 用 < 和 > 旋转建筑

en: Set the rally point for this building
Select an airstrike to call in.
This Bulldozer is constructing a building.
zh: 该推土机正在建造建筑。

zh: 松开 R1 设置集结位置。

en: Release R1 to place this building.
zh: 松开 R1 放置此建筑。

No session selected, select a session before joining.
zh: 未选择房间，请先选择一个房间再加入。

Enter a name for this game.
Game name must be at least 3 characters long
zh: 游戏名称至少需要 3 个字符

zh: 该房间已锁定，无法进入

zh: 服务器上已存在同名房间

None of the other players in the game can become the host
zh: 游戏中的其他玩家均无法成为主机

{1:s} has a different version of the game.
You need to assign players to at least two different teams.

zh: 当前任务玩家过多。请选择其他任务或踢出部分玩家。

zh: 你可以继续作为主机，或\r\n中止并让其他玩家担任主机。

zh: 你已与服务器断开连接

zh: 无法与服务器建立连接

Session is migrating to you.  You are now the host.

zh: 该房间玩家人数已达上限。

Are you sure you want to overwrite the previous save game?

zh: 你必须在计时结束前建造一座总部

zh: 你的盟友 {1:s} 有 3 分钟建造总部

zh: 你有 3 分钟建造总部

zh: {1:s} 还需防守高地 {2:s} 分钟

zh: 你的敌人 {1:s} 已在高地上建造！

zh: 在高地上建造总部并坚守 5 分钟

zh: 高地将在 5 分钟后开放

zh: 你的盟友 {1:s} 已在高地上建造！

zh: {1:s} 仍占据高地。你还有 {2:s} 分钟
